<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/blizzard-character-generator">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CharacterCreation" name="Character creation begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Split" name="Set up account and come up with names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_AccountCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_NameIdeas</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" name="Check for a Battle.net account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_AccountCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountCheck_To_AccountDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BattleNetAccount" name="Have a Battle.net account?" default="Flow_NoAccount">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountCheck_To_AccountDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountExists</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAccountInformation" name="Enter account information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterInfo_To_ClickLink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click the confirmation email link">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterInfo_To_ClickLink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ClickLink_To_AccountMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountPaths_Merge" name="Continue account setup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountExists</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ClickLink_To_AccountMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AccountMerge_To_SubscriptionCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckWoWSubscription" name="Check for an active WoW subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AccountMerge_To_SubscriptionCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubscriptionCheck_To_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" name="Have an active WoW subscription?" default="Flow_NoSubscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubscriptionCheck_To_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ActiveSubscription</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoSubscription</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select a payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoSubscription</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectPayment_To_PaymentDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod" name="Which payment method?" default="Flow_BankAccount">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectPayment_To_PaymentDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCard</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BankAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" name="Enter credit card information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCard_To_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBankDetails" name="Enter IBAN and BIC">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BankAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_To_PaymentMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentPaths_Merge" name="Continue after payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCard_To_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_To_PaymentMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentMerge_To_SubscriptionMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SubscriptionPaths_Merge" name="Continue to game">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ActiveSubscription</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentMerge_To_SubscriptionMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubscriptionMerge_To_Login</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIntoGame" name="Log into the game">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubscriptionMerge_To_Login</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Login_To_SelectCharacterOptions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCharacterOptions" name="Select realm, race and class">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Login_To_SelectCharacterOptions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectOptions_To_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ComeUpWithNames" name="Come up with character names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_NameIdeas</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameIdeas_To_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Join" name="Account and names ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectOptions_To_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameIdeas_To_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin_To_NameEntryMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameEntry_Merge" name="Choose a name to enter">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoin_To_NameEntryMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameUnavailable</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameEntryMerge_To_EnterName</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCharacterName" name="Enter the next character name">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameEntryMerge_To_EnterName</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterName_To_CheckAvailability</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckNameAvailability" name="Check character name availability">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterName_To_CheckAvailability</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckAvailability_To_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Is the name available?" default="Flow_NameUnavailable">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckAvailability_To_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameAvailable</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameUnavailable</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ConfirmationAndSelfies" name="Confirmation and character selfies received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameAvailable</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirmation_To_ExpansionMessage</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ConfirmationAndSelfies"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ExpansionMessage" name="Expansion release message received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_To_ExpansionMessage</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExpansionMessage_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ExpansionMessage"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CharacterCreation" name="Character creation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExpansionMessage_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Split" sourceRef="Start_CharacterCreation" targetRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_AccountCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_NameIdeas" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Split" targetRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountCheck_To_AccountDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckBattleNetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountPaths_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${accountExists}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount" sourceRef="Gateway_BattleNetAccount" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterInfo_To_ClickLink" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInformation" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClickLink_To_AccountMerge" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" targetRef="Gateway_AccountPaths_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountMerge_To_SubscriptionCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountPaths_Merge" targetRef="Task_CheckWoWSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionCheck_To_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckWoWSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActiveSubscription" sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionPaths_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${activeSubscription}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSubscription" sourceRef="Gateway_ActiveSubscription" targetRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectPayment_To_PaymentDecision" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${paymentMethod == 'creditCard'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankAccount" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterBankDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard_To_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCardInformation" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentPaths_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_To_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterBankDetails" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentPaths_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_To_SubscriptionMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentPaths_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionPaths_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubscriptionMerge_To_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_SubscriptionPaths_Merge" targetRef="Task_LogIntoGame"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_To_SelectCharacterOptions" sourceRef="Task_LogIntoGame" targetRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectOptions_To_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectCharacterOptions" targetRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameIdeas_To_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames" targetRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_To_NameEntryMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_SetupAndNames_Join" targetRef="Gateway_NameEntry_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameEntryMerge_To_EnterName" sourceRef="Gateway_NameEntry_Merge" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterName_To_CheckAvailability" sourceRef="Task_EnterCharacterName" targetRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAvailability_To_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Event_ConfirmationAndSelfies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nameAvailable}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameUnavailable" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_NameEntry_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_To_ExpansionMessage" sourceRef="Event_ConfirmationAndSelfies" targetRef="Event_ExpansionMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpansionMessage_To_End" sourceRef="Event_ExpansionMessage" targetRef="End_CharacterCreation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
